Houtsma Pine County Assessor 635 Northridge Drive NW, Suite 260, Pine City, MN 55063 320-591-1632 320-591-1640 assessors@pinecountymn.gov 1 (800) 450-7463 ext. 1632 Hours Monday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Tuesday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Wednesday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Thursday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Friday 8:00 am - 4:30 pm Home Departments Assessor ASSESSOR Understanding Your Property Assessment In Minnesota, the property tax system is one of the most confusing systems, as there are many different reasons your property taxes are what they are, such as: the valuation of your property, classification of your property, special programs you may qualify for, budget/levies of the local taxing authorities, and general property tax laws. The Assessor's office sets the values, classification, and works with the special programs which are established by the legislature. It is the responsibility of the Assessor's office to provide an accurate, equalized assessment and classification of all properties (approximately 32,000) within Pine County and is overseen by the Minnesota Department of Revenue. The following fact sheets are designed to help understand some of this complex system: How Market Values Are Determined Understanding Property Tax How to appeal your valuation or classification Have more questions? The Assessor's Office is here to help you with any property valuation or classification issues, concerns or questions you may have. Our office hours are Monday-Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:30 PM. The main office telephone number is 320-591-1632.
